name: Treasure
source:
A mysterious man that Lily meets in an undeveloped land. Sloppy personality.

It seems that he was disowned by his parents, and he went to the Moon easily. He gives many ambiguous responses.

A friend who rushes to Lily's side whenever she's in danger in a lawful manner.

"Well, I ... anything is fine, yeah."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
